product_overview: SaneVideo is a professional-grade native macOS application tailored for content creators, educators, and professionals. It enables high-quality screen recording with camera overlays, advanced video editing, caption generation using AI, and seamless exporting with integrated features such as YouTube upload and PDF reporting.
core_goals: Enable high-quality full-screen and window-specific video capture with camera overlays and audio inputs.
Provide a professional, intuitive timeline editor with frame-accurate scrubbing, clip manipulation, and caption editing.
Incorporate AI-driven automatic caption transcription and user-friendly caption styling capabilities.
Support efficient video exporting with real-time tracking, thumbnail generation, PDF reporting, and social media integration.
Ensure robust project management with state persistence, auto-save, and easy access to recent projects.
Deliver a smooth, accessible user experience with onboarding, keyboard shortcuts, and system-wide hotkey support.
key_features: Full-screen and window capture using ScreenCaptureKit with picture-in-picture camera overlay support.
Global hotkey (Alt+Cmd+R) and menu bar integration for quick recording control with a 3-second countdown.
Professional timeline editor featuring drag-and-drop clip arrangement, splitting, trimming, ripple delete, and audio waveform visualization.
Caption overlay with styling and Whisper AI-powered auto-transcription and editing tools.
HEVC 4K export with smart bitrate encoding, export progress tracking, thumbnail generation, PDF project reports, and YouTube direct upload.
Persistent project state management with user preferences, auto-save, and recent project access.
Accessibility support including VoiceOver, comprehensive keyboard shortcuts, and an onboarding workflow for first-time users.
user_flow_summary: Recording Flow: Launch app, select recording mode (fullscreen/window), configure camera and microphone, start recording via UI or global hotkey, 3-second countdown, record, stop, saved recording appears in timeline.
Editing Flow: Open project, arrange clips on timeline with drag-and-drop, trim and split clips, add and edit captions manually or via AI auto-generation, preview edits, and finalize.
Export Flow: Choose export settings (resolution, format), select destination, initiate export, monitor real-time progress, complete export with success notification and PDF report option.
validation_criteria: Screen and window recording functions operate flawlessly with stable frame rates and camera overlay.
Timeline editing supports all clip operations with no lag and accurate frame-by-frame scrubbing.
Caption generation uses Whisper AI with high accuracy and enables easy manual adjustment and styling.
Exported videos meet requested HEVC 4K specifications with file integrity and correct metadata.
Project persistence works reliably with state saved and restored on app restart or crash recovery.
User interface is responsive and accessible, with full keyboard shortcut coverage and VoiceOver support.
Global hotkey triggers recording start/stop consistently across system states.
Crash reports are correctly logged using MetricKit and no data loss occurs during unexpected failures.

recording: Menu bar integration with recording status
editing: Split clips (Cmd+B), trim, and ripple delete
export: HEVC 4K export with smart bitrate encoding
